cards.headline:
One truck violation.
Does the fleet stop?
body: Suppose a 20-truck carrier gets advance notice over an unqualified driver.
cards.takeaway: For a first violation, this vehicle suspension does not automatically stop the other 19.
cards.design: 트럭을 크게 두고 처분 갈래를 배치하며, 다른 차량까지 자동 정지되지는 않는다는 답을 강조합니다.
cards.promise: Read the scope of your notice

cards.headline: Read what stops, not just '30 days'

body.text: Vehicle suspension temporarily stops use of the truck directly involved in the violation.
Partial business suspension covers a set share of vehicles; full suspension stops the whole business.

cards.takeaway: Read the alleged facts alongside the proposed sanction.
cards.design: 한쪽은 위반차량 한 대, 다른 쪽은 사업의 일부 또는 전체로 정지 범위를 대조합니다.

cards.headline: Partial business suspension: how many trucks?

body.text: One-fifth of the fleet must stop.
Round 5.4 trucks down to a whole number.
Treat 0.8 trucks as the minimum: 1 truck.

cards.takeaway: Only for partial business suspension, not a first unqualified-driver violation.
cards.design: 정지 대상인 4대와 5대, 1대를 같은 척도의 막대로 비교하고 보유 대수는 행 이름으로 둡니다.

cards.headline: Unqualified drivers: first or second violation?

body.text: The default is a 30-day suspension of the vehicle involved, preventing its use for that period.
The default is removal of the vehicle involved from the permitted fleet, reducing the number of trucks covered by the permit.

cards.takeaway: A smaller permitted fleet is not a temporary suspension.
cards.design: 30일은 큰 숫자로, 감차는 허가 차량 대수가 줄어드는 그림으로 나란히 보여줍니다.

cards.headline: Was the freight driver qualified at the time?
body: Hypothetical: a driver qualified on March 20 lacked the qualification for a March 10 trip.
Match driver names, vehicle IDs and trip dates in dispatch records and waybills.
Check who assigned the trip; lack of awareness alone does not remove the carrier's liability.
cards.design: 원문의 두 날짜를 시간순으로 배치하고, 아래에는 운송기록과 사업자의 관계를 연결합니다.

cards.headline: Does a past sanction make this a repeat?
body: Unrelated violations do not automatically make this a repeat.
Normally, sanctions for the same violation within 1 year count; some types use 5 years.
Compare the earlier sanction date with the date the same violation, committed after it, was detected.
cards.takeaway: Check the old decision's provisions and dates.
cards.design: 과거 처분서와 이번 통지서를 나란히 놓고 같은 위반인지와 두 날짜를 연결합니다.

cards.headline: Read the sanction alongside the records.
cards.design: 앞선 카드의 결론 한 문장만 크게 두고 나머지는 여백으로 쉽니다.

cards.headline: One-truck owners: the permit is at stake
body: If fleet reduction is to be imposed on an operator owning only one truck, the permit must be cancelled.
If fleet reduction is mitigated, vehicle suspension must be at least 90 days.
Permit cancellation has separate mitigation rules and exclusions.
cards.takeaway: Not everyone can switch to exactly 90 days.
cards.design: 한 대 차량의 허가 문제를 위에 두고, 감차 경감과 허가취소 경감을 별도 영역으로 구분합니다.

cards.headline: How Ethos checks your records
body: Match the trip date in the notice with the driver's qualification.
Match names and vehicle IDs in dispatch records and waybills.
Check vehicles and repeat status against permits and past decisions.
Separate factual corrections from evidence for a lighter sanction.
cards.takeaway: Link each response point to supporting records.
cards.design: 통지서에서 출발해 실제 기록을 연결하고 의견에 필요한 자료를 정리하는 네 단계로 보여줍니다.

cards.headline: Unsure which vehicles the notice covers?

body.text: Gather the full advance notice, current fleet list and any past sanction decisions, and check the deadline to respond.
Ethos identifies affected vehicles, priority issues and missing records; drafting a response is a separate service.

cards.takeaway: Request a free initial review of these documents.
cards.design: 보낼 자료와 먼저 받을 안내를 두 칸으로 구분하고 무료 초기 검토 문장을 마지막에 둡니다.
